annotations.title: Check a name on the sanctions list

description: Checks a name against the latest copy of the US Treasury OFAC sanctions list (the SDN list). Returns match, possible_match, no_match, not_screened or list_behind_schedule, and each listed entry that came close: its name, type, the part that matched, its sanctions programs, and any addresses and ID numbers Treasury published. no_match means the name was compared with every entry on the list and none came close. not_screened means the name was NOT compared: it is missing, is written in whole or in part in letters or characters this screen does not read (it reads Latin letters, the digits 0 to 9 and ordinary punctuation), is only initials, or is longer than 256 characters (a name is never cut to fit; a country over 64 or an identifier over 64 characters is refused the same way); notScreenedReason says which, and a person must screen that name by hand. not_screened is never a no-hit result. list_behind_schedule means nothing came close on the copy held, but that copy is behind its refresh schedule: it is not a current screening and never a no-hit result. A country or sdnType does not remove any entry from the check: every entry's name is compared, entries tied to that country or type are listed first among equally close ones, and a match outside them is marked outsideFilter, which changes only its place in the list: it is still a match and a person must still review it. The name is not stored. A match means the name is close to a listed name, not that it is the same person or company; a person must compare the details. Information from public Treasury data, not legal advice, a compliance decision or a clearance.

country.description: Optional country. It orders the matches (entries tied to it first among equally close ones); it never removes a match.

identifier.description: Optional government/registration identifier. An entry with exactly this number is a match whatever the name.

name.description: The name to screen (person, entity, vessel, or aircraft).

sdnType.description: Optional SDN record type. It orders the matches; it never removes a match of another type.
